resolution.question: During the first week of October 2012, will major national polling organizations publicly release at least three new head-to-head surveys on the Obama-Romney presidential race?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by 2012-10-08T21:00:00-04:00, the persistent event history shows that at least three distinct major national polling organizations publicly released a new head-to-head survey of the Obama-Romney race during the period from 2012-10-01T09:00:00-04:00 to 2012-10-08T21:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO.
